title: TERE4AI v2 runtime input: AI system features
description: Structured facts about the consumer's AI system, provided by the human or coding agent. classify_ai_system consumes this; it never guesses missing facts, it reports them in missing_facts (docs/architecture.md Sections 7 and 8). Free-text description is context only; classification decisions rest on the structured fields.

description.description: Plain-language description of the system (context; not the decision basis)

domain.description: Primary domain, free vocabulary (e.g. healthcare, education, employment, law_enforcement, migration, justice, banking, insurance, critical_infrastructure, consumer)

purposes.description: What the system is intended to do, short phrases

autonomy.description: Does the output merely inform a human decision (advisory) or drive it

flags.description: Boolean facts. Absent flag = unknown, which is NOT treated as false for prohibition-relevant flags; unknowns surface in missing_facts.

creditworthiness_evaluation.description: Annex III point 5(b): intended to evaluate the creditworthiness of natural persons or establish their credit score, excluding AI systems used for the purpose of detecting financial fraud. FRIA-relevant (Article 27(1)).

life_health_insurance_risk_pricing.description: Annex III point 5(c): intended for risk assessment and pricing in relation to natural persons in the case of life and health insurance. FRIA-relevant (Article 27(1)).

deployer_actor.description: Who operates it (e.g. public_authority, private_company, individual). Free vocabulary, context only; the FRIA rule never reads it because it cannot be mapped deterministically onto the Article 27(1) legal categories. Use the structured deployer object for those.

deployer.description: Structured facts about the deploying organisation, phrased in the Article 27(1) categories. Absent fact = unknown, never treated as false; unknowns surface in the fria block, not guessed.

body_governed_by_public_law.description: The deployer is a body governed by public law (Article 27(1)).

private_entity_providing_public_services.description: The deployer is a private entity providing public services (Article 27(1)).
